Wallet ceiling unchanged - available money is not a reason to raise a stake the ledger has not licensed. v1 (wallet 500 / operating-if-billed 1200 / reserve 300) superseded.

compute_quota.arrangement: Principal is on Claude Max. A separate investment harness (7 agents) consumes ~10% of the weekly quota per day. BBP's allowance: ~5% of weekly quota per day (~35%/week), bringing combined use to ~100% by week's end.
compute_quota.hard_line: BBP must never crowd the investment harness: 5%/day is a ceiling, not a target.
compute_quota.meter: Quota consumption is not measurable from inside the harness; the principal is the only meter. Standing request: flag if BBP-attributable usage approaches the line. Absence of a flag is weak evidence, not proof, of compliance.
compute_quota.policy: Stay inside quota; overage converts to real dollars from the envelope and needs a journaled justification before it is knowingly incurred.
